Land's Wrath.theme: Obuun grows your creatures with landfall and animates a land for combat.
Land's Wrath.plan: Ramp, make repeated land drops, and put counters on Obuun before animating a land.
Land's Wrath.mulligan: Keep three lands, early ramp, and a landfall payoff.
Land's Wrath.tip: Obuun uses his power when the combat trigger resolves. A land that becomes a creature can still tap for mana.

Arm for Battle.theme: Wyleth turns each attached Aura and Equipment into a card whenever he attacks.
Arm for Battle.plan: Equip Wyleth, protect him through combat, and use each attack to refill your hand.
Arm for Battle.mulligan: Keep two or three lands, a cheap Equipment, and a protection spell.
Arm for Battle.tip: Wyleth draws when he attacks; he does not need to deal combat damage.

Reap the Tides.theme: Aesi allows an extra land each turn and draws a card whenever your land enters.
Reap the Tides.plan: Build your mana with extra lands, then deploy sea monsters and bounce opposing creatures.
Reap the Tides.mulligan: Keep three lands and early ramp or an inexpensive creature that replaces itself.
Reap the Tides.tip: Aesi permits one additional land play; lands put onto the battlefield by effects do not use that allowance.

Phantom Premonition.theme: Ranar discounts your first foretell action each turn and creates Spirits from qualifying exile events.
Phantom Premonition.plan: Set aside foretell spells, reuse creature entry abilities, and build a flying Spirit army.
Phantom Premonition.mulligan: Keep two or three lands, a mana rock, and a foretell or blink play.
Phantom Premonition.tip: Foretelling sets a card aside; it may be cast for its foretell cost only after that turn ends.

Elven Empire.theme: Lathril makes Elf Warriors from combat damage and taps an Elf army to drain the table.
Elven Empire.plan: Develop mana Elves, attack with Lathril, and preserve enough untapped Elves for her drain ability.
Elven Empire.mulligan: Keep two or three lands, a mana Elf, and an Elf payoff or card draw spell.
Elven Empire.tip: Lathril taps herself plus ten other untapped Elves. The ten supporting Elves may have summoning sickness.
